author: LiesofP
quote:
This isn't GTA. It's RDR2 in a modern setting. All the stupid, mundane, slow, boring, irritating realism mechanics are here again, except at least in RDR2 you got 
to immerse yourself in the tales of Arthur Morgan and his gang of outlaws. In GTA 6 you get to be an idealistic cuck who does chores for his girlfriend.

author: LiesofP
quote: Two years ago they released Prime 1 remastered to universal critical acclaim. So they should have been fully aware that all they had do was more of the same. But in typical Nintendo fashion, they went the route of trying to attract new audiences, severely diluting the quality of the franchise for existing fans. They did the same to Zelda and unfortunately succeeded there by turning it into a generic open world icon hunting simulator, but with Prime 4 they thankfully failed. All the concerns people had before launch turned out to be the worst aspects of the game despite what copium inhaling tourists would have had you believe. As someone who waited 18 years for this sequel, I can say without question that I've never been more dissapointed in my history with gaming.

author: LiesofP
quote: Way better than the first one, which i thought was just above average. The city actually has life now, to the point where it really feels like your swinging around NYC. In the first one it felt extremely bland and barron like a Ubisoft game, but not anymore. Couple this with the immense speed of flight it just feels awesome to play. Great job Insomniac!
